title: Ñaawoore Les Ɓoornugol
intro: Annabi gooto, tedduɗo e golle mum, waɗi feere nde addani mo woɗɗitaade leñol mum, naati e ñaawoore nde o sikkaano. Laawol makko ƴettii mbaydi teskinndi, jarribaama hoolaare makko e muñal makko e laawol ɓurngol luggiɗde. Mbele aɗa waawi ƴettude heen geɗe keewɗe e ndee hiirde teeŋtunde e nate dokkaaɗe ɗee ?
clues: Annabaajo neldaama to leñol, kono o dilli e yaawre, o nani mettere e salaare maɓɓe.
Laawol makko addani mo yahde maayo, o naati e laana ndiwoowa keewka ina ɗaɓɓa laawol.
Henndu mawndu ummii, ina hulɓina laana kaa, pellital ƴettaa ngam werlaade neɗɗo gooto e dow laana ngam ustude jolngo ngoo, ko ɗum woni ko lelni.
O ɓuuɓnaama e tagoore luggiɗnde, kewu kaawis mo yiɗde Alla yamiri.
E nder keerol reedu tagoore ndee, o noddi joomiiko, o tuubi, o mantini Alla e nder niɓɓere.
Caggal nde o ñaagii dumunna juutɗo, o werlaa e daande maayo, o ŋakkiraa semmbe kono o wuuri, caggal ɗuum o arti o tawi leñol makko ina goongɗini haa laaɓi.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu

trial.answer: Jahgol e nder reedu liingu mawngu nguu

outcome.answer: Gartugol e leñol makko ngol ndeen ngoongɗinnoo

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
